releaseNotes: Power Button Fix: Resolved critical bug where the power button triggered Google Voice / Assistant / Samsung Bixby during gameplay. Removed MediaSession VolumeProvider, replaced with safe WindowManager key interceptor — zero impact on power button on all brands (Vivo, Oppo, Samsung, Xiaomi, Infinix, Pova)
ADB Native Macro: Touch macro spam now works via native ADB daemon — identical to Shizuku and iAdb. Full 3-backend parity
Sensitivity X/Y Full Reset: All touch sensitivity overrides fully reverted to device defaults when touch listener is disabled or app is closed
Ultra-Powerful Touch Macro Spam Engine: Infinite hold-burst spamming for Gloo Wall with real-time priority loop and target coordinate redirection
Stability: Tested stable across Vivo, Oppo, Samsung, Infinix, Pova, and Android 11–16 devices
